from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import unittest
import invoice
import test_invoice
source = Path('amounts.py').read_text()
early = '    if isinstance(value, int):\\n        return value\\n'
quantized = '    return int((Decimal(value) * 100).quantize(Decimal(\"1\"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))'
assert source.count(early) == source.count(quantized) == 1
variants = {
    'current': source,
    'A-only': source.replace(early, ''),
    'B-only': source.replace(quantized, '    return int(Decimal(value) * 100)'),
}
cases = [('1.005', 101), ('-1.005', -101), ('2.34', 234)]
for name, code in variants.items():
    namespace = {}
    exec(compile(code, '<in-memory '+name+'>', 'exec'), namespace)
    with patch.object(invoice, 'amount_cents', namespace['amount_cents']):
        print(name)
        actual = []
        for value, required in cases:
            result = invoice.invoice_total(value)
            actual.append(result)
            print(f'  invoice_total({value"'!r}) = {result}; required {required}; {"PASS" if result == required else "FAIL"}'"')
        expected = [100, -100, 234] if name == 'B-only' else [101, -101, 234]
        assert actual == expected
        suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(test_invoice)
        result = unittest.TestResult()
        suite.run(result)
        print(f'  Existing tests: {result.testsRun} run, {len(result.failures)} failures, {len(result.errors)} errors')
        for test, traceback in result.failures + result.errors:
            print(f'    {test}: {traceback.strip().splitlines()[-1]}')
        assert len(result.failures) == (2 if name == 'B-only' else 0)
        assert not result.errors
PY
